note: QC night 1 (28.11.2026): risk batch of 100 + start times of the next 30 days. Descriptions and times taken from the organisers' pages.

set.description: Imagine Dragons headline Saturday's after-race concert of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix at Etihad Live. Entry is with an Abu Dhabi GP ticket; Golden Circle upgrades are sold separately.

set.title: Andre Soueid Live at Ilios
set.description: Violinist Andre Soueid mixes live violin with house beats at Ilios Beach Club on Hudayriyat Island. Doors open at 18:00.
Annual concert of the Bait Al Oud academy at the Cultural Foundation, led by Dr. Naseer Shamma, with students, graduates and master musicians. Doors 19:00, show 20:00.

set.venue: New Covent Garden Theatre, Mall of the Emirates
set.description: Festive musical pantomime of Cinderella at New Covent Garden Theatre in Mall of the Emirates. About 2 hours including an interval; ages 3+.
Family Christmas show in which two elves race to recover Santa's missing Nice List. Shows at 11:00 and 15:00 on 5, 6 and 12 December; about 1 hour 10 minutes, no interval.
A 'no-wedding' Indian sangeet party with DJ sets, live entertainers, non-stop dancing and henna artists. Doors and start at 13:00.
The Elf in the Gulf: an immersive festive adventure by Collab Company with original storytelling and Christmas music. One-hour sessions on 5 December at 11:00, 14:00 and 18:00 at Terra.
The 9th Santa Run on West Beach, Palm Jumeirah: 1 km, 3 km and 5 km in Santa suits, with kids' activities and best-dressed prizes. The 5 km starts at 08:30, 3 km at 08:35, 1 km at 08:40.

set.details: Day pass to the Yas Beach club on Yas Island, with access to its infinity pool and beach.
Saturday buffet-style brunch with food and champagne from three of the hotel's restaurants. Advance reservation required.
Weekly Tuesday quiz night from 8 PM. In December it runs as the festive Quizmas edition.
